risk_description: The diameter of front wheels of the scooter is too small (measured value: 117 mm) which can lead the scooter's wheel to become stuck on an uneven surface. Moreover, the steering tubes are not resistant to load and may collapse during use. The child might fall off the scooter and suffer injuries.
legal_provision: The product does not comply with the requirements of the Toy Safety Directive nor with the European standard EN 71-1.
